messages:
sarah: Quick sync — I want to propose a delegated responder role that can run timeboxed SIEM queries and produce short-lived exports (no CMK unwrap). Also propose TTL reduction for the high-volume audit index to 90d to control storage. Putting the summary here so folks can comment before I open a PR.
eli: Can you paste the RBAC diff and the exact retention config you're thinking of? need to check export permissions (esp raw exports).
sarah: Sure — rough draft snippet below: 
```
roles:
  - name: incident_responder_query
    perms: [siem.query, siem.export:ephemeral]
    constraints:
      - timeboxed: true
      - export_ttl: 12h
```
and retention mapping: 
```
index.high-volume-audit.ttl: "90d"
index.high-volume-audit.masking: "minimal"
```
devsec-bot: automated-check: CMK unwrap still flagged as high-risk if allowed. Recommend proxy-based tokenized exports that don't grant decrypt rights to the role. Log all proxy unwrap attempts.
tj: If exports are tokenized and TTL=12h that seems OK for triage, but we need to ensure an auditable justification field on every export request. Also who can escalate to full raw export?
sarah: Plan is: incident_responder_query uses proxy tokens for scrubs/snapshots. Full raw export will require manager approval + ticket (no auto unwrap). We'll emit an export_request_id and an audit entry with user, justification, and policy version.
ops-ana: :thumbsup: On storage/perf — moving high-volume-audit to 90d will cut cost but may increase cold reads. Suggest hot/cold tiering: keep 0-30d hot, 31-90d warm, snapshot older to S3 for long-term forensic needs.
eli: We should also update the oncall playbook with exact steps: how to request a tokenized export, what fields are required, and the escalation path for full raw. I'll take that item unless someone else wants it.
sarah: Thanks — one question: who signs off on 90d? Compliance might want 180d for some event classes. @tj any constraints from compliance?
tj: Compliance flagged certain auth & e2e-security events as 180d retention. Can we tier by sensitivity label at ingest? e.g. auth_failures=180d, infra_debug=30d, default=90d.
sarah: Yes — proposal: tag events at ingest with sensitivity labels and apply TTL mapping. I'll add a mapping table to the PR.
devsec-bot: automation note: create a detection that fires on any SIEM export missing justification or missing export_request_id. Filing rule (rule-1203) now.
ops-ana: I'll spin up the proxy pilot today and test: token issuance, export_ttl enforcement, and audit logging. Will report perf and any failed unwrap attempts by EOD Friday.
sarah: Action items captured: sarah -> PR RBAC + TTL mapping; ops-ana -> proxy pilot; tj -> confirm compliance exceptions and list event classes; eli -> update oncall playbook and runbook. Sync tomorrow 10:00am to review pilot results. :calendar:
